warnings: *** REWRITTEN AFTER A-13 WAS READ - THE FIXTURE NUMBERS ARE NOW RESOLVED. *** This file first recorded 4 fittings by their circled digit alone with fixture_type_not_resolved, because neither A-11 nor A-12 prints a legend. A-13 (หน้า14) carries รายละเอียดสุขภัณฑ์ห้องน้ำ, a ten-row table keying every digit. Those entries have been renamed to the scheduled fixture and their flags cleared; the printed digit is kept in printed_as and the source of the name is stated on each element. The earlier reading is recorded here rather than deleted, per the append-or-rewrite rule - it is the honest record that this sheet alone could not identify them.
*** THIS SECTION IS WHAT SETTLES THE +3.90 / +3.95 DISAGREEMENT ON ITS OWN SHEET - see the plan file's warning. It prints +3.95, matching A-05 and A-08.

ระดับฝ้าเพดาน 2.60 ม. IS A HEIGHT ABOVE THIS ROOM'S FLOOR, NOT AN ABSOLUTE LEVEL. It is written without a plus sign, unlike every absolute level in the set, and 2.60 m absolute would put the bathroom ceiling below the upper floor slab. Recorded as 2.60 with the reading stated on the element; the absolute soffit would be 3.95 + 2.60 = 6.55 but that arithmetic is deliberately not written into level_m, because the sheet does not state it.

FIXTURE NUMBERS ON THIS SHEET ARE CIRCLED DIGITS KEYED TO A SCHEDULE THAT IS NOT ON IT. The plan and section tag fittings 1 to 10 with circled digits and no legend appears on A-11. Only the ones whose icon is unmistakable are named here (pan closet, wash basin, shower head, floor drain); the rest are recorded by their printed number alone with a flag, because naming a fitting from a 10-pixel icon is exactly the kind of guess §10's SI-versus-S1 warning is about. A-12 and A-13 (แบบขยายห้องน้ำ 2 และ 3) and the SN sheets are where the key should be.

The section's bottom chain reads 0.40 + 0.40 + 0.40 + 0.40 + 0.30 + 0.70 with 2.00 and 0.80 printed as sub-totals, and 0.10 for the counter upstand; the right-hand chain gives 0.60 / 1.45 / 2.05 for the tiling and shower heights.
